site_description: Kaku is an open-source web app for learning Japanese up to JLPT N5: kana, spaced-repetition vocabulary, a dictionary and grammar practice, in English and Spanish.
hero_title: Learn Japanese from your first kana to JLPT N5
hero_lead: Kaku puts kana drills, vocabulary review, a dictionary and grammar practice in one place, so your time goes into studying instead of switching tools.
modules_lead: Each one covers a part of the beginner path. They are being built in this order.
module_kana_body: Drill hiragana and katakana by typing the reading or picking it from a list. The kana you miss most come back more often.
module_review_body: Study vocabulary with spaced repetition: each card returns just before you would forget it. Start from ready-made N5 decks or build your own.
module_dictionary_body: Search by kanji, kana, rōmaji or meaning, and turn any entry into a card in one step.
module_import_body: Bring your .apkg decks with their audio, images and review history, and continue where you left off.
module_grammar_body: Read a short explanation of each N5 point, then practise particles, word order and conjugation.
module_resources_body: A curated list of books, sites and tools worth your time beyond Kaku.
progress_title: Everything counts toward the same progress
progress_body: Reviews and exercises earn XP toward a daily goal you set. Meet it and your streak grows; levels and achievements mark the longer road.
status_body: Kaku is under construction and the modules are arriving one by one. The code is open source, so you can follow the work or take part in it.
